==Overview==
Over the past three months, several events have occurred which are of significance to the Empire and may require a response from her champions. You can also read about the progress of the Empire's military campaigns [[379YE Summer Solstice winds of war|here]].

===Bloody Murder===
In the months leading up to the Summer Solstice, four civil servants were murdered. You can learn more about this event [[Bloody murder|here]].

===Blue Seas, White Stone===
The powerful Tarquinius family of the [[Asavean Archipelago]], in conjunction with the trade advisor to the [[Asavean Archipelago#politics|Plenum]], have sent an emissary to attend anvil during the Summer summit - and their arrival has caused some controversy. You can learn more about this event [[Blue seas, white stone|here]].

===Calling the Drottningbjotha===
Hirak the Huntsmaster, herald of [[Cathan Canae]], has announced the ''Drottningbjotha'' at Anvil - a contest of champions not just from the Empire but from lands both nearby and distant. You can learn more about this event [[Calling the Drottningbjotha|here]].

===Crossroads===
There is a tide in magic that speaks of momentous choices. You can learn about this "conjunction" [[Crossroads|here]].

===Golden Sails===
A major Grendel [[navy|navy]] has dropped anchor off the southern coast of [[Feroz]]. Apparently it is serving purely as the escort for a diplomat intending to negotiate at Anvil ... but the threat of potential violence is palpable. You can learn about this event [[Golden Sails|here]].

===Green and Pleasant Lands===
A group of orcs out of [[the Barrens]] have suddenly appeared in the [[Navarr]] territory of [[Brocéliande]]. They appear to be on their way to anvil. You can learn more about this event [[Green and pleasant lands|here]].

===Little Boats===
A diplomatic delegation of [[Druj]] [[orc]] is on their way to [[Casinea#Anvil|Anvil]] under the protection of the [[Amend_law_of_delegation_protection|law]]. You can learn more about this event [[Little boats|here]].

===Lonely, Dark and Deep===
The [[vallorn]] of [[Brocéliande]] stirs fitfully, thrashing in response to tighter [[trods]] and [[Druj]] meddling. You can learn more about this event [[Lonely, dark and deep|here]].

===News from the North===
The people of [[Wintermark]] have been dealing with a number of [[curse|curses]] and blessings. You can learn more about these events [[News from the north|here]].

===Promises to Keep===
A diplomatic delegation of [[Thule]] orcs has come down from frozen [[Otkodov]], to parley with the Empire - and with the [[Varushka|Varushkans]] in particular. You can learn more about this event [[Promises to keep|here]].

===Reikos Flux===
Sickness has struck [[Reikos]], and has spread through both the armies and the remaining [[Highguard|Highborn]] population. You can learn more about this event [[Reikos flux|here]]

===Shadow in the West===
The [[Jotun]] are about to launch a series of punitive raids across the western border into the Empire focusing on territories in [[the Marches]], [[the League]], and [[Wintermark]]. You can learn more about his event [[Shadow in the west|here]].

===Sing a Sad Song===
Heralds of the eternal [[Lashonar|Lashonar the loquacious]] have mobbed the [[Dawn_military_concerns#The Golden Sun|Golden Sun]], bringing with them an infectious and intoxicating ballad that is having unlooked for effect on the soldiers of Dawn. Left unchecked, the situation is likely to escalate. You can learn more about this event [[Sing a sad song|here]].

===Strange Allies===
The Lasambrian Hills are invaded - twice. They are sending a delegation to Anvil - but so are the [[Iron Confederacy]], and the [[Jotun]] have left little doubt that interference with their conquest of the northern hills will end the existing peace. You can learn more about this event [[Strange allies|here]].

===Trade Winds===
Imperial [[fleet|fleets]] have encountered unexpected problems when travelling to [[foreign ports]]. You can learn more about these events [[Trade winds|here]].

===Unmade Trove===
A [[Urizen_leadership#Torchbearers|Torchbearer]] and her companion find a treasure with massive implications under a shattered tower in [[Redoubt]]. You can learn more about this event [[Unmade trove|here]].

===Unquiet Dead===
The [[Druj]], even in retreat, continue to taunt the Empire. The slaughter of their slaves - first at the [[Holberg#The Great Pits of Ennerlund|Great Pits of Ennerlund]] and then at the [[Reikos#The Vigilant Swan|Vigilant Swan]] has given rise to scores of angry, terrified, hate-filled ghosts who haunt the mine and the quarry preventing all progress on reopening these [[Bourse]] resources. You can learn more about his event [[Unquiet dead|here]].

===Unwelcome Guest===
The [[Highguard_military_concerns#The_Seventh_Wave|Seventh Wave]] engage twisted spring horrors in [[Casinea]]. You can learn about this event [[Unwelcome guest|here]].

===Wolf in Summer===
All four of [[the League]] cities have been struck by [[Icy Maw Devours the Spark of Essence|curses]] that have a deleterious effect on [[Magical skills#Magician|magicians]] and [[mana site|mana sources]]. You can learn more about this event [[Wolf in summer|here]].
